'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Brian Herold DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time]]
* '''Username:''' Permanent screen name is pending
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
